title: Chilled Silken Tofu with Soy and Chilli Oil
dish_title: Silken tofu with soy and chili oil
summary: A chilled block of silken tofu dressed with soy, rice vinegar, sesame oil and chilli oil, topped with spring onion.

ingredients.item: x 400 g blocks silken tofu, chilled

steps.title: Dressing
steps.text: Whisk the soy sauce, vinegar, sesame oil, chilli oil and sugar until the sugar dissolves.

steps.title: Plate
steps.text: Open the tofu, pour off the water and ease each block whole onto the rimmed plate; blot away any liquid.

steps.title: Dress
steps.text: Spoon the dressing over and around the tofu so it pools on the plate.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Scatter with sesame seeds, spring onion and coriander and serve straight away with spoons.

tips: Keep the tofu cold until serving.
Use a rimmed plate so the dressing pools.
Spoon the tofu with plenty of dressing.
storage: Best eaten straight away. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
